deadline.value: The catalog gives no department deadline for this PhD; the Graduate School priority date for international Fall applicants is March 1.
deadline.quote: International Student Priority: March 1 Priority: August 1 $75 Secondary: April 30 Secondary: September 30 $135

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: The GRE is required only for direct admission from a bachelor's degree (310 or more in verbal and quantitative, 3.5 analytical writing); master's applicants are not asked for it on this page.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores of 310 or greater in Verbal and Quantitative skills and 3.5 in Analytical Writing.

supervisor.value: Admission does not require a faculty agreement; an advisor is chosen after admission, before 12 PhD credit hours.
supervisor.quote: Before completing 12 PhD credit hours at WSU, a student must select an advisor and an advisory committee.

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding rule for this PhD; the Graduate School's assistantship range is not a per-student guarantee.
funding.quote: assistantships for 20 hours of work per week for a nine-month period range from $5,800 to $25,000

entry_route.value: Applicants with a master's degree are admitted under the standard rules, and exceptional bachelor's graduates can enter the PhD directly.
entry_route.quote: The mechanical engineering department offers direct admission for truly exceptional students to its PhD program. | A master’s degree in mechanical or closely related engineering, or physical sciences.

notes: Aerospace Engineering also offers a PhD (catalog: https://catalog.wichita.edu/graduate/engineering/aerospace-engineering/phd-in-aerospace-engineering/) in the same field. Only one record fits this field id, so the aerospace PhD is not saved here. Its bachelor's-entry track needs a faculty letter naming the student's advisor, and its master's track is admitted by the department chair. Department web pages are blocked.
name: PhD in Mechanical Engineering
